name: ENSy lexical dataset derived from the Penn Treebank
note: PROVISIONAL: built without all three tokenizers; not valid for experiments

rules.normalisation: lower-case, alphabetic only, proper nouns (NNP/NNPS) excluded
rules.artefacts: clitic stems (always before n't) excluded; function-word forms that are name-internal (NNP count >= other count, or >50% of occurrences between two NNP tokens) excluded
rules.disambiguation: majority category over all PTB occurrences; ties and out-of-partition majorities excluded
rules.single_token: exactly one id, add_special_tokens=False, not unk/special, decodes back to the word, in every model
rules.balancing: n per category = min category size; most frequent forms kept
